modern: One thing only troubles me: that I might do something which the constitution of man does not allow, or in a way which it does not allow, or which it does not allow now.
original: One thing only troubles me, lest I should do something which the constitution of man does not allow, or in the way which it does not allow, or what it does not allow now.
notification: One thing only troubles me: that I might do something which the constitution of man does not allow, or in a way which it does not allow, or which it does not allow now.
notification_original: One thing only troubles me, lest I should do something which the constitution of man does not allow, or in the way which it does not allow, or what it does not allow now.

explained.summary: Only one thing worries Marcus: that he might do something human nature doesn’t allow, or do it in the wrong way, or at the wrong time. Everything else, from pain to loss to other people’s behaviour, he tries to leave unworried about. His only real concern is acting badly himself.
